title: NadFusion
tagline: Seamless cross-chain swaps between EVM and Monad powered by 1inch Fusion+
description: This project had the goal of developing a cross-chain swap between EVM And Monad, but I only managed to deploy contracts, and I had trouble using the 1inch Fusion+ SDK. The project compiles but is missing some components in order to be fully functional. It was going to be a CLI app for cross-chain swaps.
how_its_made: It uses foundry to compile and deploy EVM contracts to Sepolia and Monad, and it uses Golang and leverages the 1inch SDK to access Fusion+ API's needed for order creation and signing. I use VSCode and some AI tools to develop the code and verify the correctness. It tries to use Fusion+ API's.
